answer: Cost-of-replication accounting turns sybil into a capital question: each identity posts a bond capped per epoch, so ten thousand clones lock ten thousand bonds to split one agent's ceiling. Because the quorum must span unrelated subnetworks, those clones cannot grade each other and must rent outside jurors, which makes every marginal clone lose money and sends the whole tide of fake accounts back into the ocean it came from, a wander nobody bothers to repeat.
